variant.title: MinMax Sudoku
variant.description: A marked cell must be smaller or larger than all of its orthogonal neighbors.
rule_guide.title: MinMax Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: An inward-triangle cell is smaller than all of its orthogonal neighbors; an outward-triangle cell is larger than all of them.
rule_guide.item_3: For example, if a Minimum cell contains 3, every orthogonal neighbor must be greater than 3.
